test_title: PYST 12: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

You studied mathematics in Class X,_______ you?
solution:
The correct answer is "**didn't**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in the **past tense**.
 
• We need to use a tag question like **didn't **since the sentence is in the past tense.
 
• Didn't is the contraction of **did not.**
 
• Didn't is used when trying to d
